voice.summary: Metroform sounds like a planner who prefers conversation to jargon. It explains where homes, offices and parks could go in short, concrete sentences.
dos: Name the district type before the number
Explain method steps in everyday words
Frame planning as a conversation with the council
donts: Do not use words like stakeholder or smart city
Never present a model as a final decision

taglines: Test the plan before the first brick
Homes, offices and parks, in balance
Model it first, build it better
boilerplate: Metroform is a planning studio that helps councils test where homes, offices and parks should go through interactive models, before a single brick is laid.
